fieldValues.title: Tools that undo a readable structure
fieldValues.summary: Structures that pass the audit are still shown badly by today's tools.
evidence: srs-rust#1490: navigation loses outline order and depth; proposes a coverage report
srs-web#668: the container pane lists search hits, not the outline
srs-web#425: the editor's navigation shows two levels
srs#726: find cannot search a tree of sections
srs#928: compositions have no display title; srs#911: headings jump from H1 to H3
No command orders a package's compositions, so a front door cannot be put first
fieldValues.body: Each is logged where it lives. The order and depth of navigation (srs-rust#1490) and the container pane (srs-web#668) are the two that most often hide a good structure.
